correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, the antipodal quotient edge/equality tests follow from Hamming weights 1,n-1 and 0,n. The profile-extension splitting enumerates every new vertex. The four-round Hintikka recursion exhaustively resolves n=2..16, with direct graph-level code independently agreeing for n=2..7; the uniform 2h-to-h splitting lemma proves complete tail equivalence for all n>=16. Both sides of the claimed equivalence and sharp representative bound follow from these certified finite partitions and the independent infinite lemma. Finite checks are not used for n>16.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete low-rank first-order classification for antipodal quotients of hypercubes, a structurally distinct classical distance-regular family. The dimension-eight/nine logical collision despite opposite bipartiteness, the dimension-ten stabilization, and the optimal 512-vertex representative quantify precisely the observable effect of folding. The uniform splitting lemma supplies an interpretable infinite stabilization mechanism beyond mere table enumeration. It is not a parameter relabeling or immediate implication of the ordinary hypercube classification.
